formation: Simplified form of 稱.  Phonosemantic compound. 禾 represents the meaning and 爯 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "measure weight". The meaning later shifted to "lift", "raise", "praise", "reputation", and "call".

components.note: Alludes to measuring the weight of grain.
Shorthand for the 爯 component in the traditional character 稱.
